search_command: gi-rule-synth.py joint-search --regions train-regions examples/regions --out new-full --cache new-cache --jobs 96 --time-s 30 --cost-slack 0 --semantic-variants 6
measure_command: eval/joint_measure.py --llc llc-measure --td measure-all.td --rules new-full/rules.json --baseline joint/rules.json(6 rules of 2026-11-12) --manifest manifests/amdgpu-validation.txt --exclude manifests/amdgpu-discovery.txt -j 96
heldout_command: eval/joint_measure.py --llc llc-final --evaluate <15 ids> --manifest manifests/amdgpu-heldout-codegen.txt --exclude manifests/amdgpu-discovery.txt --exclude manifests/amdgpu-validation.txt (run once, after the selection was frozen)
